title: Umthuthukisi Wezinhlelo Zenethiwekhi
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Umsebenzi

Umfakizicelo ophumelelayo uzophathiswa lokhu okulandelayo:

  • Ukuklama, ukwakha nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwezingxenye zezinhlelo zenethiwekhi ze-Kyber
  • Ukuphenya nokuxazulula izinkinga eziyinkimbinkimbi eziphathelene nokusebenza, ukuphathwa kwememori, ukuvumelanisa kanye nokuphepha
  • Ukulungisa amaphutha ezingeni eliphezulu (ukuhlaziya amarekhodi okuphahlazeka, ukulungisa amaphutha emongweni wesistimu yokusebenza, ukuhlaziya isitaki, futhi ngezikhathi ezithile ukuhlaziya izinhlelo ngokuhlehla ukuze kuqondwe ukwakheka kwazo)
  • Ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe ecacile nezohlala isikhathi eside
  • Ukubamba iqhaza ezinqumweni zokwakheka kwezinga eliphansi nasekubuyekezweni okubucayi kwekhodi
  • Ukuqhubeka nokulandelela intuthuko yezobuchwepheshe mayelana nokusebenza kwangaphakathi kwe-Windows namathuluzi asezingeni lesistimu

Amakhono Obuchwepheshe Adingekayo

  • Ulwazi olubanzi kakhulu lokwakheka kwenethiwekhi nemvelo yayo yezobuchwepheshe
  • Ukuqonda okujulile kwezisekelo zokuxhumana kwenethiwekhi (TCP/IP, UDP, ukulawula ukuminyana kwedatha, ukweqa i-NAT, ukubethela, nemigudu yokusakaza)
  • Ukuqonda okuqinile kwemiqondo yesistimu yokusebenza (imicu yokusebenza, ukuhlelwa kwemisebenzi, imemori, okokufaka nokukhipha (I/O), amasokhethi)
  • Isipiliyoni esisebenzayo sokusebenzisa amathuluzi okulungisa amaphutha nokuhlaziya inethiwekhi
  • Isipiliyoni esifakazelwe kwesisodwa noma ngaphezulu kulezi zivumelwano: QUIC (kuyimpoqo), WebRTC, HLS, RTMP, USB ngaphezu kwe-IP
  • Izilimi Zokuhlela: C / C++ / Rust / X86/x64
  • Amathuluzi Nendawo Yokusebenza: i-Git nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ngokubambisana

Wena

  • Iminyaka emi-5 kuya kweyi-10 yesipiliyoni somsebenzi ekuthuthukisweni kwesofthiwe, ugxile kakhulu ekuhleleni kwenethiwekhi
  • Isipiliyoni ezindaweni ezishumekiwe noma ezinemikhawulo yezinsiza
  • Ukujwayela imigudu yemidiya, ukuxhumana ngesikhathi sangempela, noma ingqalasizinda yokusakaza
  • Ulwazi lokuxhumana kwenethiwekhi ezingeni lomongo wesistimu yokusebenza noma lokwakha izindlela zokuthutha ezenziwe ngokwezidingo ezithile
  • Isipiliyoni sokusebenza nezinhlelo ezisebenza ezinkundleni eziningi (Linux, macOS, Windows, izistimu zokusebenza ezishumekiwe)
  • Ukucophelela okuphezulu, ukuzimela nokunaka imininingwane, kanye nentshisekelo enkulu yokuxazulula izinkinga zobuchwepheshe ezingelula
  • Ikhono lokwabelana ngolwazi nokweluleka onjiniyela abasaqala
  • Amakhono Angaba Yinzuzo: Isipiliyoni kwezokuphepha kwesistimu noma ekuqiniseni ukuphepha kwezingxenye ze-Windows, isizinda sokuhlaziya izinhlelo ngokuhlehla noma sokuhlaziya isofthiwe enonya, iminikelo kumaphrojekthi omthombo ovulekile agxile ezingeni eliphansi noma ezinhlelweni zesistimu
  • Amakhono Angaba Yinzuzo: Isipiliyoni ezindaweni ezinemikhawulo (izinhlelo zesikhathi sangempela, ukutholakala okuphezulu, isofthiwe lapho ukuphepha kubaluleke khona kakhulu)

Inqubo Yokuxoxisana

  • Ucingo Lokuqala Lwemizuzu eyi-15 — Ingxoxo emfushane mayelana nogqozi lwakho, ukuthi uvumelana kanjani nathi, nokuphendula imibuzo yakho engaphathelene nobuchwepheshe.
  • Izingxoxo Ezimbili Zobuchwepheshe Nomkhiqizo Zehora Ngayinye — Ukungena ngokujulile endleleni yakho yokuxazulula izinkinga, no-CTO wethu kanye/noma umakhi wethu omkhulu wezixazululo
  • Ukwazana Nethimba — Umhlangano ongahlelekile ukuze siqiniseke ukuthi uzozizwa usekhaya emasikweni ethu okusebenza.

Esikunikezayo

  • Amaphrojekthi agxile kakhulu kwezobuchwepheshe naphonsela ingqondo inselele
  • Indawo yokusebenza ehlonipha ubungcweti bangempela bobunjiniyela futhi egxile kwezobuchwepheshe (ayikho imihlangano engenamsebenzi noma imibiko engadingekile)
  • Ukuzimela okuphelele ekuthatheni izinqumo zobuchwepheshe
